title: Visual realism comparison
headerExplanation: Watch the two videos and answer the question below.
selectionText: Press the start button after reading the explanation.
explanation: In this exercise you will evaluate different systems that generate human animations. You will be shown pairs of videos. You have to watch these videos, and you will be able to rewatch them any number of times. Some pairs might show similar motion, but others might show more different motion: don't pay attention to how similar or not the two videos are, just focus on which one looks more realistic to you.

Then, you will have to choose which one has the most realistic looking motion. For that, in each pair of videos, you will have to choose the strength of your preference out of 5 different options, to also define the strength of your choice. In other words, this will be the question that you will have to answer for each pair of videos:

Which video has the most realistic looking motion? Response options: (A) Video 1, clear preference; (B) Video 1, slight preference; (C) No preference; (D) Video 2, slight preference; (E) Video 2, clear preference.
You will be shown 20 pairs of videos in total. Please, it is very important that you try to pay attention to each video until the end of the test, and give the best answer that you can.
Thank you in advance for spending time to complete this task. Your participation is very useful and important to us.
mainQuestion: Which video has the most realistic looking motion?
thankYouText: Thank you for participating in this exercise, your responses have been saved. Your participation is very useful and important to us.
feedbackLabel: Write your feedback here, and press the button
feedbackText: Finally, you can write any feedback that you have about this exercise. This step is optional, your responses are already registered. You may close the window.
